activity.role: Poet and writer of The Raven
activity.notes: The Raven circulated and was published in American newspapers/journals in 1845; Library of Congress records January 29 Evening Mirror print and American Review version, so representative 1845 point has specific source. Not fictional 'Edgar Allan Poe' from Bungo Stray Dogs. Original author identity (1809–1849).
